show_work.caveats: One invoice can contain several categories, so orders by category do not add up to total orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-24' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-31'

show_work.definition: Gross revenue divided by the number of orders.
show_work.caveats: With a category filter this is category revenue per order that contains the category.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-24' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-31'

show_work.definition: Number of distinct identified customers with at least one sale in the period.
show_work.caveats: Guest orders have no customer ID and are not counted.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-24' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-31'

show_work.definition: Share of identified customers in the period whose order was not their first order in this dataset.
show_work.caveats: The data starts in December 2009, so customers who bought before then look new. Early months understate this rate and inflate "new" customers.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND customer_type = 'returning' THEN customer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-24' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-31'

show_work.definition: Returns divided by gross revenue, by value.
show_work.caveats: Returns and sales in the same period are not necessarily the same orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT -SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-10-24' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-10-31'

summary.text: For the retail week ending 2011-10-24, net revenue reached £234,203, representing a week-over-week decline of -9.6% compared to £259,054 the previous week, and performing at -3.0% below the prior four-week average of £241,493. Despite the drop in overall revenue, order volume rose significantly to 519 orders, marking a +16.4% increase week-over-week and sitting +13.9% above the four-week average of 456. However, the average order value fell to £467.60, down -21.1% from £592.73 and -14.7% below the four-week average of £548.03. Customer engagement remained strong with 419 customers, a +15.1% increase, and a repeat customer rate of 88.8%. Performance drivers included Lighting as the top category driver, while the Netherlands acted as the primary country driver despite a previous decline.
